Rashi on Eruvin 19a:10:1.hebrew: ולא מבשקר - איננו מכירו שהוא יהודי, דמשכה ערלתו, ודומה לו כמי שאינו נימול:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:10:1.english: And he does not recognize - He does not recognize that he is a Jew, for his foreskin was drawn and he appears to him like one who is uncircumcised:

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:11:1.hebrew: המוציא והמעלה - המוציא אתכם מארץ מצרים (ויקרא כ״ב:ל״ג), וכן המעלה אתכם מארץ מצרים (שם יא):
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:11:1.english: “He Who brings out” and “He Who raises up” - [As in the verse,] “Who brings you out of the land of Egypt” (Leviticus 22:33), and similarly, “Who raises you up out of the land of Egypt” (ibid. 11).

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:11:2.english: That they rebelled - During their lifetimes.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:13:1.english: Out of the belly of the netherworld - Jonah son of Amittai said it.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:15:1.hebrew: בדבי רבן יוחנן בן זכאי - ברייתא שנסדרה בבית מדרשו, כעין תוספתא שסידר ר' חייא ור' אושעיא:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:15:1.english: In the school of Rabban Yoḥanan ben Zakkai - A baraita that was compiled in his study hall, similar to the Tosefta that Rabbi Ḥiyya and Rabbi Oshaya compiled.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:16:1.hebrew: טיט היון - הוא רפש לטבוע בו, ובלע"ז פנ"ק. וסתם טיט, היינו שראוי לבנין:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:16:1.english: Tit HaYaven [Miry clay] - It is mire in which to sink, and in Old French, fanc [mud]. And ordinary tit [clay] is that which is suitable for building.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:16:2.english: Shaḥat and Be’er Shaḥat - They are one and the same thing.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:18:1.english: For gratuitous matters - [Namely,] forbidden sexual relations.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:19:1.hebrew: תפתה - גיהנם, דכתיב בההוא קרא: ״מדורתה אש ועצים הרבה״:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:19:1.english: Tofte - [This refers to] Gehinnom, as it is written in that verse: “its pyre is fire and much wood.”

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:1:1.hebrew: למטעי כרם - ויהנו שכיניה, ושבח הוא לה שנזכרת לטובה:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:1:1.english: For planting vines - And its neighbors will benefit, and it is praise for [Samaria] that it is mentioned for good.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:20:1.english: Beit She’an is its entrance - For its fruits are sweeter than [those of] all the Land of Israel.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:20:2.english: Would praise the fruits of the right bank - He would praise the fruits of the bank of the Euphrates River on its south.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:23:1.hebrew: רבקה נכנסת ורבקה יוצאת - ולא פרה נכנסת ופרה יוצאת, דא"כ לא הוו להו קשורות:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:23:1.english: A team enters and a team leaves - And not a cow enters and a cow leaves, for if so, they would not be tied together.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:23:2.hebrew: כמה ראשה ורובה של פרה - שנתנו חכמים שיעור להרחקת פסין מן הבור, שיהו רחוקין כדי ראשה ורובה, כדתנן במתני':
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:23:2.english: How much is the head and most of the body of a cow - [This refers to that] which the Sages gave as a measure for distancing the upright boards from the cistern, that they must be far enough to accommodate its head and most of its body, as we learned in the Mishnah.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:2:1.hebrew: חכה - עץ שפותח פיו, שלא יכול לדבר:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:2:1.english: A hook - A piece of wood that holds open his mouth, so that he cannot speak.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:3:1.hebrew: לך דומיה - הכל שותקין כנגדך. שדומה עליו כו' — נוחין לו יסורין, שמקבלן מאהבה:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:3:1.english: To You silence [is praise] - All are silent before You. “It appears to him, etc.” — Afflictions are agreeable to him, as he accepts them with love.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:3:2.hebrew: שדומה עליו כו' - נוחין לו יסורין, שמקבלן מאהבה:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:3:2.english: It appears to him, etc. - The suffering is agreeable to him, for he accepts it with love.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:3:3.hebrew: ולך ישולם נדר - אותה דומיה שהוא דומה ביסורין, דומה לו כשילום נדר:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:3:3.english: And to You shall the vow be performed - That silence with which he is silent under suffering is considered for him like the payment of a vow.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:4:1.hebrew: מעין ישיתוהו - כמעין של שיתין — נקב שבבנין המזבח, שניסוך היין של ספלים יורד לתוכו כל השנה, כדאמרי' בלולב וערבה (סוכה מט.):
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:4:1.english: Turn it into a spring - Like the spring of the *shitin* — a cavity in the structure of the Altar into which the wine libation of the bowls descends all year, as we say in [the chapter entitled] *Lulav Ve-Aravah* (Sukkah 49a).

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:6:1.hebrew: הפושעי' בי - עדיין, ואפי' בשעת תולעתם ואשם:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:6:1.english: Who rebel against Me - Still, and even at the time of their worm and their fire.

Rashi on Eruvin 19a:8:1.hebrew: דא"כ - דהא דר"ל בפושעי ישראל מוקי לה להאי קרא, דכתיב: "ואשם לא תכבה" — קשיא דידיה אדידיה:
Rashi on Eruvin 19a:8:1.english: For if so - For since Reish Lakish establishes this verse, where it is written: “And their fire shall not be quenched,” regarding the sinners of Israel, his [statement] contradicts his [own statement].

Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:15:1.hebrew: בר מבא וכו' - לא שייך למחשביה בהזהב (ב"מ דף נח:) גבי שלשה יורדין לגיהנם ואינן עולין, דזה עולה כשקיבל דינו. והא דלא חשיב התם פושעי ישראל בגופן והצדוקין כו' דאין עולין — לפי ששנויים בברייתא. ואע"ג דמלבין פני חבירו חשיב ליה, ותני ליה במס' אבות — מ"מ אשמעינן דמכנה שם הוי מלבין, אע"ג דדש ביה בשמיה:
Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:15:1.english: "Except for [one] who had relations..." etc. - It was not appropriate to count him in [the chapter entitled] HaZahav (Bava Metzia 58b) regarding [the] three who descend to Gehenna and do not ascend, because this [person] ascends once he has received his judgment. And as for that which [the Gemara] does not count there the sinners of Israel with their bodies and the Sadducees, etc., who do not ascend — [that is] because they are [already] taught in a baraita. And even though it counts one who humiliates his fellow, and it is taught in Tractate Avot, nevertheless it comes to teach us that calling [someone a derogatory] name is [considered] humiliating [him], even though he has grown accustomed to [being called by] that name.

Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:15:2.hebrew: דילמא היינו דירושלים - כדכתיב (יהושע טו): "גיא בן הנם וגו' ירושלים". ולא גרסינן: "היינו דמדבר":
Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:15:2.english: "Perhaps this is the [entrance] in Jerusalem" - As it is written (Joshua 15): "The valley of Ben Hinnom [...] Jerusalem." And we do not read: "This is the [entrance] of the wilderness."

Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:17:1.hebrew: באר שחת כדכתיב כי לא תעזוב נפשי לשאול לא תתן חסידך לראות שחת - [והיינו באר שחת]. ומהאי קרא הוה מצי לאתויי דשמו שאול. והא דלא מייתי קרא "ואתה אלהים תורידם לבאר שחת" — דהאי קרא בקבר כתיב, כדמוכח סיפא דקרא: "אנשי דמים ומרמה לא יחצו ימיהם":
Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:17:1.english: “Be’er Shaḥat, as it is written: ‘For You will not abandon my soul to the netherworld; nor will You suffer Your pious one to see the pit’” - [And this is Be’er Shaḥat]. And from this verse [the Gemara] could have brought [proof] that its name is She’ol. And as for that which it did not cite the verse: “And You, God, will bring them down to the pit of destruction [be’er shaḥat]” (Psalms 55:24) — [that is] because that verse is written concerning the grave, as is proven by the end of the verse: “Men of blood and deceit shall not live out half their days.”

Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:17:2.hebrew: וצלמות דכתיב יושבי חשך וצלמות - האי קרא בתהלים כתיב, גבי ארבעה צריכין להודות; ונראה כספרים דגרסי: "בטרם אלך ולא אשוב אל ארץ חשך וצלמות" (איוב י׳:כ״א). [חיתית גרס; דתחתית כתיב ביחזקאל (ל"א), כשהראה הקב"ה שכל הגוים יורדים לגיהנם, כתיב שם: "אל ארץ תחתית"]:
Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:17:2.english: "And Tzalmavet, as it is written: 'Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death [tzalmavet]'" - This verse is written in Psalms regarding the four [categories of people who] must give thanks. And it appears [correct] according to those texts that read: "Before I go whence I shall not return, to the land of darkness and the shadow of death [tzalmavet]" (Job 10:21). [One should read [in the Gemara] Ḥitit; for Taḥtit is written in Ezekiel (ch. 31), when the Holy One, Blessed be He, showed that all the nations descend to Gehenna, it is written there: "to the nether earth [el eretz taḥtit]"].

Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:19:1.hebrew: והאיכא תפתה - תימה, דלא חשיב עלוקה. ור"ת מפרש: דעלוקה שם חכם, כמו "לאיתיאל". והא דמוקי ליה במסכת עבודה זרה (דף יז.) בגיהנם — היינו משום דכתיב בתריה: "שאול ועוצר רחם". ומיהו קשה: דבפסיקתא לא חשיב להם בשמות שלמה, וגם בג' דברי' וד' דברים הכתובים באותו ספר לא חשיב עלוקה; ואע"ג דלא חשיב נמי יקא — היינו משום דשמא הוי בכלל אגור. והפייט נמי יסדו בשם גיהנם, בזולת "אין צור": "חלף יקדו בהבהבי עלק":
Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:19:1.english: “Isn’t there [also] Tofte” - It is puzzling that [the Gemara] does not count Alukah. And Rabbeinu Tam explains that Alukah is the name of a wise man, like “to Itiel” (Proverbs 30:1). And that which [the Gemara] establishes it in tractate Avodah Zarah (17a) as [referring to] Gehinnom, that is because it is written after it: “Sheol, and the barren womb” (ibid. 30:16). However, this is difficult, for in the Pesikta it does not count them among the names of Solomon; and also in [the midrash on] “three things and four things” written in that book, it does not count Alukah. And even though it does not count Yakeh either, that is because perhaps it is subsumed under Agur. And the liturgical poet also established it as a name for Gehinnom in the Zulat [beginning] “Ein Tzur”: “In return, they burned in the flames of Alak.”

Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:20:1.hebrew: אם בין הנהרות הוא - משמע דבין הנהרו' לאו היינו בבל, ודלא כפ"ה שפי' בי' יוחסין (קדושין דף עב.) גבי בין הנהרות הרי הוא כגולה ליוחסין. ובפירקין (דף כב:) נמי אמרי': בבל נמי מקיף לה פרת מחד גיסא ודגלת מחד גיסא:
Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:20:1.english: "And if it is between the rivers" - This implies that "Between the Rivers" is not Babylonia, unlike the explanation of Rashi, who explained in [the chapter entitled] Asarah Yuchasin (Kiddushin 72a) regarding "Between the Rivers, it is like the Diaspora with respect to lineage." And in our chapter (22b) we also say: "Babylonia is also surrounded by the Euphrates on one side and the Tigris on the other side."

Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:8:1.hebrew: [פושעי ישראל אין אור שולטת בהן ק"ו ממזבח הזהב - תימה: דבמס' חגיגה (דף כז.) עביד ק"ו מסלמנדרא, דתלמידי חכמים אין אור שולטת בהן מק"ו! וי"ל: דפושעי ישראל פניהם משחירי', ואלו תלמידי חכמי' — כלל וכלל לא]:
Tosafot on Eruvin 19a:8:1.english: ["The sinners of Israel, the fire has no power over them, an a fortiori [inference] from the golden altar" - It is astonishing: For in Tractate Chagigah (27a) [the Gemara] makes an a fortiori inference from the salamander, [when the fact] that the fire has no power over Torah scholars [could be derived] from an a fortiori [inference from the sinners of Israel]! And it can be answered that [as for] the sinners of Israel, their faces are blackened, whereas [as for] Torah scholars, not at all.]
